name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: Global manufacturing PMI eased to 52.6 in October; costs rising
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Manufacturing PMI fell to 52.6 in October from 53.0, published 2 Nov, still well above 50; input cost inflation accelerated amid material shortages and delivery delays. China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3. The global composite for October is due on 4 Nov.
for_you: Global industry is still growing, but rising input costs tend to feed into prices of manufactured goods.

sources.title: S&P Global — J.P.Morgan Global Manufacturing PMI, October

why: Purchasing-manager surveys are the fastest read on whether the world economy is expanding or contracting.
drivers: Orders, inventories, trade policy, energy costs, credit conditions.
